claims.statement: Northgate Business Park sold in March 2025 (per the XLSX comps sheet, sale date 2025-03-14) for $41,000,000, at a price of $276.10 per square foot across 148,500 square feet of building area, with net operating income of $2,152,500.
The narrative memorandum describing the same transaction confirms the sale month, price, and price per square foot: it traded in March 2025 for $41,000,000 ($276.10 per square foot).

citations.quote:
Northgate Business Park traded in March 2025 for $41,000,000 ($276.10 per square foot) at a
cap rate of approximately 6.10%, consistent with prevailing suburban office cap rates at the
time the asset was first underwritten.

claims.statement: The two evidence sources report conflicting cap rates for this same transaction: the underwriting memorandum states a cap rate of approximately 6.10%, while the comps workbook records the cap rate as 5.25%.
